back: The spreading of a wave through a gap or round an obstacle.
When the gap or obstacle is about the same size as the wavelength.

front: Sound vs light through a doorway
back: Sound λ ~ 1 m diffracts; light λ ~ 5 × 10⁻⁷ m does not noticeably.
Long-wave λ ~ 1 km diffracts round hills; FM (~3 m) and phone (~0.2 m) signals need line of sight.

front: Why the slits in Young's experiment are narrow
back: Diffraction at each slit makes the beams overlap so they can interfere.
Nearly semicircular wavefronts, same spacing as before.
Diffraction: spreading at a gap/edge in one medium. Refraction: direction change from a change of speed.
